about: Register, renew or end a tenancy contract in the Dubai Now app and sign it with UAE PASS.
note: Requirements read from the official Dubai Land Department service page on the checked date. The sign-in forms do not publish their field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Register, renew or end a tenancy via Dubai Now. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Owners who manage their own property, and their tenants
A valid Emirates ID is needed
fees: AED 177.75 for registering a tenancy contract, including service, knowledge and innovation fees and VAT
